mentl/216952b:
Integrates the insight that surfaced while analyzing this week's
bugs as a class. Every latent bug the WASM bootstrap has surfaced
has had the same shape: a place where a cheaper flat question was
asked when a richer structural answer was one step away in the
pipeline. In every case the fix was to trust the structure that
already existed and stop cheating with a flat shortcut.

- `if op == "Concat" { TString }` — hardcoded type when the graph
  already held operand types waiting to unify
- `PLit(e) => LPLit(LUnit)` — threw the literal away when the SExpr
  wrapper was one unwrap deep
- `insert_field_sorted_at` base case `[field]` — dropped the sorted
  prefix that was sitting right there in the argument
- `is_global("xs")` flat lookup — bypassed env_lookup which already
  tracks lexical scope via most-recent-binding-wins

The Rust VM's leniency has been whispering answers the pipeline
should be reading from its own graph. Stripping Rust strips the
charity. The bugs were always there — Rust was filling in questions
we weren't asking ourselves.

CLAUDE.md gains a "THE STRUCTURAL QUESTION" section that frames the
principle alongside "THE FIRST RULE," with the operational protocol
to run before any compiler fix. docs/INSIGHTS.md gets the full story
with the four bugs as worked examples and the self-hosted / self-
contained distinction spelled out. A new feedback memory captures
the principle for future sessions.

Not just "one more rule" — this is the lens through which every
remaining shortcut between here and a self-contained Lux compiler
gets found.
sonido/2165d84:
Enabling D-cache during SAI DMA initialization causes bus matrix stalls
that starve the DMA controller, resulting in SAI overrun errors. This is
an undocumented interaction between the Cortex-M7 cache enable sequence
and Embassy's ring buffer DMA driver.

Architecture changes:
- configure_mpu() now takes (mpu, scb) only — enables MPU + I-cache
- New enable_dcache() public function for callers to invoke when safe
- init_sdram! macro drops $cpuid parameter (2 args instead of 3)
- MPU Region 1 marks D2 SRAM (0x30000000) non-cacheable for DMA coherency

Usage patterns:
- With audio: spawn deferred_dcache() task (~500ms delay before audio setup)
- Without audio: call enable_dcache() immediately after init_sdram!

Morph pedal also migrated from D2 SRAM heap (256 KB) to SDRAM heap (64 MB)
with deferred D-cache pattern. Audio callback is passthrough while controls
and morph logic are being validated.

BREAKING CHANGE: init_sdram! macro signature changed from
($p, $mpu, $scb, $cpuid) to ($p, $mpu, $scb). configure_mpu() no longer
takes CPUID parameter. Callers must call sdram::enable_dcache() separately.
